task: P02-T3 follow-up (#592): NaspRemote drops stale NASP replies after a receive timeout; native-client README limits Unknown to a sent Commit
summary: 43/100 unchanged. NaspRemote gains a receive-only path: after a bounded receive gave up on a queued send (Delivery::Sent, Unknown), a late reply with an older correlation is dropped without resending, at most once per earlier Unknown, so later exchanges stay aligned; a newer correlation, a wrong opcode or an undecodable frame stays Unknown. Host regression test plus the unchanged six-stage native NAS gate. P02 stays open: no client persistence, in-boot NAS restart, real transport, identity or power loss; no native late-reply stage.
